theme: Agree and keep up: See eye to eye, Accept vs Except...

pages.title: See eye to eye
examples: We don't see eye to eye on this.
They rarely see eye to eye.

pages.title: Keep up with
pages.meaning: to move or learn at the same speed
examples: I can't keep up with you!

pages.title: Hit the nail on the head
examples: You hit the nail on the head!
Her answer hit the nail on the head.

pages.title: Break down
pages.meaning: to stop working, or to start crying
examples: My car broke down on the highway.
